📲 Ilovani o'rnatish (PWA)

Ushbu platformani MacBook yoki telefoningizga ilova sifatida o'rnatib, 100% oflayn (internetsiz) foydalanishingiz mumkin.

💻 MacBook (Google Chrome & Microsoft Edge):

Brauzer manzil qatoridagi o'rnatish (⊕) belgisini bosing yoki quyidagi tugmani bosing:

🍎 MacBook (Safari — macOS Sonoma 14+):

Safari menyusidan: Fayl (File) → «Dokka qo'shish...» (Add to Dock...) ni tanlang.

📱 iPhone / iPad (Safari):

Pastki «Ulashish» (Share ⎋) tugmasini bosing va «Bosh ekranga qo'shish» (Add to Home Screen) ni bosing.

🤖 Android (Chrome):

Brauzer menyusidan (⋮) «Ilovani o'rnatish» yoki «Bosh ekranga qo'shish» ni tanlang.
